slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Area of any triangle: A = (1/2)ab sin C. Law of Sines: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C. Law of Cosines: c2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab cos C.

The area formula comes from A = (1/2)bh with height h = a sin C. The Law of Cosines becomes the Pythagorean Theorem when C = 90 degrees, since cos 90 degrees = 0.

Enrichment: these are not in the 2023 Indiana Geometry standards. Obtuse angles need sine and cosine beyond right triangles, which Algebra II defines.
